label: A behaviour eval harness that evaluates the harness not the models: a scripted engine replays deterministic turns, the runner boots a real server and freezes evidence, and scorers are pure functions over the frozen snapshot that never touch a server
Gate files hold a turn open for deterministic busy windows, so a concurrency test needs no sleep and no race
Current pins state each behaviour with its issue number and a negative clause saying what it is not, e.g. a new message is not a cancellation
An evaluation-layer taxonomy separates regression contracts (k=1, reported per behaviour) from workflow capability (k=3, reported as a rate), and forbids averaging them into one score
A scenario whose graded behaviour is deliberately absent from its instruction file, so passing proves the production base prompt carries the behaviour rather than the task text
An attachment eval supplies the file through an attachments array and deliberately omits it from setup.files, so a model that looks on disk finds nothing
A per-bot app view API is host-authenticated and read-only, and loads the host package by file path under a content-hashed module name so two copies do not collide in sys.modules
